name: Chevening Scholarship
coverage: Full tuition fees, monthly living stipend, return economy flights, visa fee reimbursement, and arrival allowances.
eligibility: Egyptian citizens holding a bachelor's degree with at least 2 years of work experience.
notes: Covers one-year master's degrees in any UK university. Applications for 2026/2027 open August 2025.

name: DAAD Study Scholarships - Fine Arts, Design, Visual Communication and Film
coverage: Monthly stipend of €934, travel allowance, health insurance, and annual study allowance.
eligibility: Egyptian nationals with a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Design, Visual Communication, or Film.
notes: Requires portfolio submission following specific DAAD portal instructions.

name: DAAD Study Scholarships - Architecture
coverage: Monthly grant of €934, international travel allowance, health insurance, and study allowance.
eligibility: Egyptian citizens holding a first university degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or Urban Conservation.
notes: Portfolio of architectural design work is a critical selection component.

name: Fulbright Egyptian Student Program (Master's Degree)
coverage: Tuition fees, living allowance, health insurance, airfare, and university placement assistance.
eligibility: Egyptian citizens residing in Egypt with a bachelor's degree and proven English language proficiency.
notes: Provides full funding for master's programs in the US, including specialized art institutes.

name: Italian Government (MAECI) Grants for Foreign Students
fundingBody: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
coverage: Monthly allowance of €900, tuition fee exemption at public institutions, and health insurance.
eligibility: Egyptian citizens under 28 years old (30 for PhD/AFAM) holding an appropriate academic degree.
notes: Covers programs at Italian universities and AFAM institutions (Higher Education in Art, Music and Dance).
